incidents.summary: Multiple rapidly moving, glistening objects observed from the air near Mount Rainier, Washington.
Visual and radar observations of unidentified flying objects over Washington, D.C.
Radar screen showing multiple signal blips tracked on June 18, 1953.
Four small, light-colored circular objects arranged in a horizontal line observed on July 16, 1952.
